entities.summary: Geoff Workman was an English record producer and engineer, best known for producing and engineering albums for The Cars, Queen, Journey, Foreigner, Drivin N Cryin, Toto,Dokken, Mötley Crüe, Private Eye and Twisted Sister. In the late 1970s, he engineered several albums with Roy Thomas Baker, eventually leaving in the 1980s to become a full-time producer. He produced the band Secretz at Cherokee Studios with Darrahl Foley. Geoff called Denver, Colorado home during the 1990s, where he produced and engineered for bands such as the Hippie Werewolves, Dogs of Pleasure, Killian Dare and Strange Parade, as well as Logan out of Houston TX.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a renowned record producer and engineer, Geoff Workman's contributions to the music industry had a significant regional impact in Northern Europe during the late 20th century. His work with notable bands such as Queen, Journey, and Mötley Crüe helped shape the sound of rock music in the region.
